publication.title: Merlin: A Computed Tomography Vision-Language Foundation Model and Dataset

sources.primary_authority: The final Nature author manuscript defines the linear-probe training recipe.
sources.code_availability_note: The official repository exposes inference and model code but no complete linear-probe training script; values not reported in the paper are identified below as implementation choices.

paper_exact.head_lr: The linear probes use AdamW with an initial learning rate of 1e-5.
paper_exact.epochs: The linear probes are trained for 10 epochs.
paper_exact.scheduler_decay_epochs: The cosine scheduler is configured to decay to zero over a 300-epoch horizon.
paper_exact.min_lr_factor: Zero represents the reported cosine endpoint.
paper_exact.early_stopping_patience: Zero disables early stopping so the reported fixed 10-epoch training duration is retained.

official_code_backed.embedding_dim: Merlin(ImageEmbedding=True) returns the pooled 2048-dimensional image representation before the separate 512-dimensional contrastive projection.

unreported_runnable_implementation_choic.head_weight_decay: The paper does not report probe weight decay; 0.01 is PyTorch AdamW's default and is not claimed as publication-exact.
unreported_runnable_implementation_choic.warmup_epochs: Warmup is not reported; zero adds no unsupported warmup.
unreported_runnable_implementation_choic.max_grad_norm: Gradient clipping is not reported; zero disables it.
unreported_runnable_implementation_choic.batch_size: Probe batch size is not reported; one is the project-safe default and may be changed only through publication_derived provenance.
unreported_runnable_implementation_choic.grad_accum_steps: Gradient accumulation is not reported; one disables it.
unreported_runnable_implementation_choic.min_delta: Checkpoint-selection tolerance is not reported; zero represents strict improvement when validation is used by the project protocol.

fixed_architecture_and_task_adaptations.encoder: All Merlin image-encoder parameters are frozen and the encoder remains in evaluation mode.
fixed_architecture_and_task_adaptations.head: A single Linear(2048, 5) layer is initialized with the explicitly recorded PyTorch Kaiming-uniform convention.
fixed_architecture_and_task_adaptations.loss: Multiclass class-weighted cross-entropy is used because the project has one mutually exclusive label per CT; the publication used masked BCE for incompletely labelled multilabel findings.
fixed_architecture_and_task_adaptations.splits: The project's patient-level five-fold development protocol and fixed held-out cohort are retained for comparison with its other strategies.

known_methodological_differences: The publication's supervised findings experiment uses thirty independent binary heads with masked binary cross-entropy; this project uses one five-logit head, multiclass cross-entropy, and argmax for mutually exclusive labels.
The project uses inverse-frequency class weights consistently across its supervised Merlin classifiers; weighting is not reported for the publication's linear-probe experiment.

The publication uses private 15,331-scan training and 5,060-scan validation cohorts and evaluates 10% and 100% training regimes; this project uses its own patient-level percentage manifests, five-fold CV, full-development refit, and fixed held-out cohort.

The publication does not report probe batch size, weight decay, warmup, random seed, Kaiming variant, or checkpoint-selection rule. Numeric values required by this runner are explicitly classified as implementation choices rather than publication-backed facts.
Frozen image features are materialized once in FP32 for deterministic reuse across folds; feature-extraction precision is not specified by the publication.
The project selects CV checkpoints with 0.7*macro-F1 + 0.3*balanced accuracy and reports multiclass accuracy, balanced accuracy, macro-F1, AP, classwise metrics, and confusion matrices.
